channel.title: The Wang Report
channel.description: Independent news curation from Hong Kong: geopolitics, finance, cyber, AI, sports, science, and culture.

item.title: SFC issues Investor Identification Regime roadmap and client consent circular for exchange-traded derivatives
item.description: Two SFC circulars dated 30 September give derivatives intermediaries a build schedule and a consent procedure, and the consent half is the one that needs a client to answer.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: FDA Approves Daraxonrasib For Pancreatic Cancer After Trial Shows Survival Nearly Doubled
item.description: The approval of a drug aimed at the RAS switch in this cancer gives patients a new choice, with a survival gain that is still a ratio rather than a promise.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Netflix Collects Lee Chang-dong, JYP Collects The Word "Fan
item.description: One company bought a director's entire shelf while another registered the name for its audience, and both are the same kind of deal.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Lamb Catches 17 Passes And The Winning Touchdown, And Dallas Keeps Houston Winless
item.description: CeeDee Lamb's 12-yard score with 40 seconds left beat the Texans 34-30, and Houston scored 30 points and still has no win.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: A Protein Restriction Paper Is Being Sold as Longevity News to People Who Can Least Afford to Lose Muscle
item.description: A Cell Metabolism paper describes a coordinated whole-body response to eating less protein, and the press release does not say who or what was studied.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: OpenAI Says It Disrupted a Coordinated Effort to Copy Its Models Through Its Own API
item.description: The traffic that trains a rival looks like paying customers, so the buyer's own usage now sits inside the vendor's extraction monitoring.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: Zelenskiy Says Russia May Have Handed North Korea Its Jet-Drone Technology
item.description: The claim arrives the same weekend Pyongyang reported a hypersonic drill and an expert put Guam and parts of Alaska inside the range of its latest missile test.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai

item.title: TA419 phishes US AI policy experts with Microsoft adversary-in-the-middle lures
item.description: A China-aligned group is going after the people who write AI policy, and the lure works against the second factor most of them were told to enable.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Taiwan's Envoy Takes The Stalled Arms Sale To Washington In Public
item.description: Taipei has moved a request it could not close in private onto the record, in a week when the administration's attention sits in the Gulf.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Technical University of Denmark Breach Exposes Data of Up to 200,000
item.description: The attackers reached the directory that records who everyone is and what they may open, so the 200,000 figure measures the size of the list, not the harm done.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Hong Kong share sales hit record US$47.5 billion in third quarter, as nine-month IPO haul reaches HK$388 billion
item.description: Three record totals circulated over the weekend, and the reports do not say whether they count the same thing.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Rays One-Hit The Yankees In ALDS Opener With Aaron Judge Off The Roster
item.description: Drew Rasmussen and Bryan Baker held New York to a single hit Saturday night, and the Yankees now fill out a Game 2 card down 0-1 without the man who anchors it.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Kai Tak Hospital opens in phases
item.description: Kowloon East finally gets its hospital, but a phased opening means the building is there before everything in it is.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Technical University of Denmark breach exposes data of up to 200,000 people
item.description: The attackers reached the university's identity and access management system, the one database that holds every account and who may open what.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: SFC issues circular on Single Submission Arrangement with Securities Commission Malaysia for dual listings
item.description: An issuer listing in Hong Kong and Malaysia at once can now file once, which also means one set of disclosure has to satisfy two regulators.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Skubal Retires 15 Straight, And The Dodgers Lead Atlanta 1-0
item.description: The Dodgers' October bet on one left arm paid on the first night, with Shohei Ohtani still managing a bad knee and biceps.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Benjamin Mok and George Tsoi lined up to support Public Service Commission probe into Wang Fuk Court fire failings
item.description: The probe looks at how civil servants handled the Tai Po fire, and the two people helping it are senior civil servants.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Warlock Ransomware Group Breaches Water, Telecom and University Targets Through SharePoint Flaws
item.description: The victims share a document server, not an industry, which suggests the group picked targets by what they were running rather than who they were.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: SFC and AFRC sign new MoU extending cooperation to financial reporting of licensed firms and funds
item.description: A licensed firm's accounts now have a second regulator with a standing channel to the SFC, which changes who reads the footnotes and who they report to.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Boston Dynamics Gives Atlas A Four-Finger Hand, Built For Tools And Abuse
item.description: The company says the new hand pairs the dexterity of complex manipulation with the strength and durability to survive real work, two goals that usually pull against each other.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Minnesota Beats Michigan For The First Time Since 2014, And Bryce Underwood Never Saw It Coming
item.description: The Golden Gophers' defense buried a quarterback who arrived as the crown jewel of a recruiting class, 20-14, and ended a twelve-year drought.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Myostatin Inhibitors Grow Muscle That Fails to Get Stronger
item.description: Drugs that preserve lean mass keep failing to boost strength, just as FDA leaders weigh how to judge aging therapies.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: A Fourth OpenAI Safety Employee Quits, Saying the Culture Is Broken
item.description: The resignation comes two days after OpenAI cut ties with three safety researchers, leaving customers to ask who is checking the agents they are about to buy.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: Kyiv Closes Five of Its Six Bridges as Zelenskyy Promises Harder Strikes on Russian Refineries
item.description: Ukraine's answer to a bridge campaign is aimed at the refinery accounts that fund the 27 percent rise in Russia's 2027 war spending.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai

item.title: Hong Kong public universities raise non-local undergraduate tuition up to 26% for 2027-28
item.description: Non-local students get a bigger bill and, according to SCMP, more places to pay it in.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Warlock ransomware group breaches water utility, telecom operator and university through SharePoint flaws
item.description: BleepingComputer reports the China-linked group got in through SharePoint vulnerabilities at four organisations that have little in common except a document server.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Taiwan Water-Cannons A Chinese Fishing Boat At Dongsha And Beijing Gets Its Footage
item.description: Taipei used the lowest rung of force at the island it holds closest to China's coast, and it did so where a camera could see it.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Croatia vs England Nations League, England lead 2-0 in Rijeka through Kane and Bellingham
item.description: The match kicked off at midnight Hong Kong time, so most of us are finding out over breakfast.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Coleman Wong wins Asian Games tennis gold in Nagoya, beats Wu Yibing 6-2, 6-4
item.description: The Hong Kong player's first Asian Games gold also earns him a place at the Olympics.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Fortinet Warns Critical FortiMail Flaw Is Being Exploited as a Zero-Day
item.description: A mail gateway flaw already on CISA's exploited list means the real exposure for any firm is a date, namely how long its box sat unpatched after the listing.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Fortinet FortiMail zero-day CVE-2026-104286 rated 9.8 exploited, as HKCERT issues Fortinet warning
item.description: Fortinet's FortiMail flaw reached CISA's exploited list on 1 October, a day before HKCERT's Fortinet bulletin, and the same week Dark Reading found backdoors dressed as Asian mail security products.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Ohtani Admits He Is Not Fully Healthy, And Dodgers Open The NLDS Anyway
item.description: The left knee and right biceps that dogged him all summer come with him into October, and the Dodgers are betting Tarik Skubal covers the difference.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Gulf Oil Is Nearly Back to Pre-War Volumes, Routed Around the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Shuttle tankers and bypass pipelines have carried Middle East exports close to where they stood before the Iran war, which is why the currency market, and not the oil market, is where the war shows up.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai

item.title: Hong Kong foreign domestic helper minimum wage rises 2.35% to HK$5,220, food allowance unchanged
item.description: The raise works out to about HK$120 a month, and the government says the stronger economy is why.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: China Speeds Work On Antelope Reef Runway As The Pentagon Sends A Third Carrier To The Gulf
item.description: Satellite imagery shows construction gathering pace on a Paracel Islands reef, in the same week Washington committed more ships to the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: HSBC shares fall nearly 5 percent through HK$150 as Hang Seng sheds 640 points
item.description: HSBC and Standard Chartered led an index drop that Futubull ties to Treasury yields, and a bank balance sheet reacts to that differently than an equity screen does.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Hong Kong customer service scams cost victims HK$220 million in August, triple the monthly average
item.description: Fraudsters posing as customer service officers took more in one month than they usually take in three, and the trick is old enough that you would think we'd all be sick of it by now.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: MTR Pays Hong Kong Government HK$2.25 Billion Over High-Speed Rail Delays
item.description: The government collected from a company it mostly owns, and public reporting shows the payment but not how a HK$5.05 billion dispute came to settle at that figure.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: MTR pays HK$2.25 billion to Hong Kong government over high-speed rail delays
item.description: The government is the majority shareholder of the company it just collected from, which makes the HK$2.25 billion payment a transfer from one pocket of the same family to another.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: An Interstellar Comet's Ice Carries Ten Times The Solar System's Heavy Hydrogen
item.description: Comet 3I/ATLAS, photographed from Mars, holds ice far richer in deuterium than the solar system's, and the number works as a thermometer for a place we cannot visit.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Chris Sale Closes Out Philadelphia On One Day Of Rest, And The Braves Get The Dodgers
item.description: Atlanta's ace turned a deciding Game 3 into a four-out relief job, and the reward is Tarik Skubal on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: OpenAI Delays Its IPO Over Safety, Cuts Ties With Three Safety Researchers, and Keeps Shipping Agents
item.description: The company has put a public-market date on hold for safety reasons in the same week it parted with safety staff and put a dinner-ordering agent in reviewers' hands.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: Russia Logs Its Worst Month of 2026 in September, Against a Budget Built to Pay for More
item.description: Ukraine's military puts Russian losses at 46,230 killed or wounded last month, the highest of the year, in the same week Moscow struck Kyiv's bridges and power grid.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai

item.title: MTR pays HK$2.25 billion over rail construction delays, deal avoids payout on Sha Tin to Central Link
item.description: The rail company and the government have settled what the delays cost, and the number is bigger than most of us will ever see on an Octopus card.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Three Linux backdoors disguised as Asian mail security products found on edge systems
item.description: A mail security gateway is the one box an administrator is told never to question, which makes it a convenient costume.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Washington Sends A Third Carrier To An Iran War Its Defence Secretary Says Is Won
item.description: Nine thousand US troops are heading to the Middle East while Taiwan's defence ministry keeps counting Chinese aircraft and ships, and Beijing can count both.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: New World Development Pays $430 Million to Exit Airport Mall 11 Skies
item.description: A developer is paying to leave a shopping mall and booking a $3.6 billion loss, and the Airport Authority is taking the project back.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: SFC suspends trading in Silver Grant International shares over suspected diversion of more than 1 billion dollars in loan proceeds
item.description: The SFC's Enforcement Division froze the stock a week ago Friday on a suspicion about where borrowed money went, which leaves every holder and lender with a price that has not moved since.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Dodgers Open Their Three-Peat Bid Saturday At 1 P.M., And The NLDS Schedule Has Fans Grumbling
item.description: The two-time defending champions get a cable slot for Game 2 and a weekday afternoon for Game 3, which is how the league treats a dynasty it expects to see in the later rounds anyway.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Nine Thousand US Troops Sail for the Middle East, and the Bill Goes to the Navy's Operating Accounts
item.description: A deployment announced by a single US official on Thursday commits ships, fuel and maintenance hours that the Pentagon will have to find in its operating budget.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai
